mods.name: Voxel 3D
mods.description: Rebuilds the overworld as a voxel diorama, textured from the cartridge's own tileset and drawn at the window's resolution, stages a battle on the map it was started on, and stands the opposing trainer behind their Pokemon. Choose it on this page to draw the overworld and the fight alike. Q and E or the wheel zoom, I and K raise and lower the camera.

mods.name: Randomizer
mods.description: A save-bound run generated from a four-digit seed: Pokemon, wild sources, items, badges, shops, species, moves and trainer teams. Critical placements are accepted only after the host finds no visible self-lock.

mods.name: Follower
mods.description: A Pokemon out of its ball and walking one cell behind you, drawn with the cartridge's own party icon for its species. Pick which slot comes out, whether it stays out on a bike and on the water, and put it away with one press. Face it and press A to pet it: it looks back, cries and wears the cartridge's own heart. It can find hidden items for you too, if you turn that on.

mods.name: Overworld Encounters
mods.description: Replaces random steps with a bounded population of visible roaming wild Pokemon drawn from each map's own encounter tables, with visible shiny Pokemon.

mods.name: Hidden Stats
mods.description: A fourth page on a Pokemon's stats screen, in the cartridge's own two-column shape: the four DVs the species was born with, HP's own derived from them, and the stat experience each of the five has trained.

mods.name: Linking Cord
mods.description: The item the later games sell instead of asking for a friend: use it on a Pokemon that only evolves by being traded and it evolves where it stands. Sold on Goldenrod Dept Store's second floor, and spent by the evolution it causes.
